title: Institutional Benchmarks
subtitle: Marist compared with peer and aspirant groups
author: Office of Community and Belonging

release.note: NCES/IPEDS final Complete Data Files; group medians exclude Marist

intro: Selected measures from the public IPEDS benchmarking dashboard for the 2023–24 final collection, unless a trend chart notes otherwise.

chapters.heading: Overview
chapters.body: Six headline measures: undergraduate enrollment, acceptance rate, first-year retention, six-year graduation, average net price, and Pell Grant recipient share. Peer and aspirant comparisons use institution-level medians.

figures.title: First-year retention rate
figures.caption: Full-time, first-time undergraduates returning the following fall (RET_PCF).

figures.title: Six-year graduation rate
figures.caption: Bachelor’s degree within six years for the applicable entering cohort (GBA6RTT).

callouts.label: Reading the comparisons
callouts.body: Peer and aspirant membership follows Marist’s published lists. Medians exclude Marist. Higher retention and graduation are favorable; lower average net price is favorable.

chapters.heading: Graduation trend
chapters.body: Across five final collections, Marist’s six-year graduation rate edged down from the late-2010s peak while remaining near the peer median and below the aspirant median.

figures.title: Six-year graduation rate, five final collections
figures.caption: GBA6RTT by collection year. Source: embedded dashboard overview extracts.

chapters.heading: Affordability snapshot
chapters.body: Average net price for aided full-time first-time undergraduates sits above both comparison medians in 2023–24. Pell recipient share is slightly below the peer median and above the aspirant median.

figures.title: Pell Grant recipient share
figures.caption: UPGRNTP, undergraduates awarded Federal Pell Grants.

bullets: Enrollment (EFUG): Marist 5,545; peer median 5,514.5; aspirant median 6,437.
Acceptance rate (DVADM01): Marist 65%; peer median 71%; aspirant median 27%.

notes: Sample figures from dashboard-primitives overview extracts, final collections 2019–20 through 2023–24. Definitions match docs/metric-definitions.md. Prefer processed JSON over live NCES downloads at render time.
